sources.label: Governor’s announcement
sources.evidence_excerpt: Abbott announced limits on permit issuance while state entities reviewed the effects of data centers on the grid and water.

sources.label: Abbott directive
sources.evidence_excerpt: The governor directed TCEQ to pause issuance of all permits related to data center projects.

sources.label: TCEQ response
sources.evidence_excerpt: TCEQ described screening pending applications and suspending some claimed authorizations where possible.

sources.label: Houston Chronicle
claims: Hall County permit discrepancy and developer response
sources.evidence_excerpt: The newspaper documented continuing work at six or more reviewed sites and attributed the Hall County authorization claim to QTS.

sources.label: The Texas Tribune
sources.evidence_excerpt: The Tribune reported that TCEQ resumed regular review after notice from Abbott’s office.
